=== about
Consecutive inner patches of one selector and consecutive append patches of one list: a client may merge them (the last inner wins, the appends concatenate); the page is the same applied one by one or merged.
=== page
<div id="log"><p id="status">old</p><div id="out"></div></div>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #status
data: elements a

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #status
data: elements b

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #status
data: elements <i>c</i>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #out
data: elements <li>1</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #out
data: elements <li>2</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #out
data: elements tx

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #out
data: elements t<b>3</b>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: selector #status
data: elements <p id="status">new</p>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: selector #status
data: elements <p id="status">newer</p>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #status
data: elements end

=== dom
<div id="log"><p id="status">end</p><div id="out"><li>1</li><li>2</li>txt<b>3</b></div></div>
